convert_script = '''
from fpdf import FPDF
from docx import Document

doc = Document("docs/customer_report.docx")

pdf = FPDF()
pdf.set_auto_page_break(auto=True, margin=15)
pdf.add_page()

for element in doc.element.body:
    tag = element.tag.split("}")[-1] if "}" in element.tag else element.tag

    if tag == "p":
        from docx.text.paragraph import Paragraph
        para = Paragraph(element, doc)
        text = para.text.strip()
        if not text:
            pdf.ln(4)
            continue

        style_name = para.style.name if para.style else ""

        if "Heading" in style_name:
            if "0" in style_name or "Title" in style_name:
                pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 20)
                pdf.cell(0, 14, text, ln=True, align="C")
            elif "1" in style_name:
                pdf.ln(4)
                pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 15)
                pdf.cell(0, 10, text, ln=True)
            else:
                pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 12)
                pdf.cell(0, 8, text, ln=True)
            pdf.ln(2)
        else:
            pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "", 11)
            pdf.multi_cell(0, 6, text)
            pdf.ln(2)

    elif tag == "tbl":
        from docx.table import Table
        tbl = Table(element, doc)
        num_cols = len(tbl.columns)
        col_width = (pdf.w - 2 * pdf.l_margin) / num_cols

        pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "", 10)
        for i, row in enumerate(tbl.rows):
            if i == 0:
                pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 10)
                pdf.set_fill_color(200, 220, 255)
            else:
                pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "", 10)
                pdf.set_fill_color(255, 255, 255)

            for cell in row.cells:
                cell_text = cell.text.strip()
                pdf.cell(col_width, 8, cell_text, border=1, fill=True)
            pdf.ln()
        pdf.ln(4)

pdf.output("docs/customer_report.pdf")
print("PDF created successfully at docs/customer_report.pdf")
'''
await write_file("./convert_to_pdf.py", convert_script)
print("Conversion script written")

result = await run_command("python ./convert_to_pdf.py")
print(result)

email_script = '''
import smtplib
import os
from email.mime.multipart import MIMEMultipart
from email.mime.base import MIMEBase
from email.mime.text import MIMEText
from email import encoders

msg = MIMEMultipart()
msg["From"] = "agent@cuga.dev"
msg["To"] = "bob@example.com"
msg["Subject"] = "Customer Activity Report - Maya Chen"

body = """Hi Bob,

Please find attached the Customer Activity Report for Maya Chen.

Report highlights:
- Customer: Maya Chen
- Order: ORD-6C71B1 (2026-09-02)
- Order Total: $79.00

Best regards,
Cuga Agent"""

msg.attach(MIMEText(body, "plain"))

pdf_path = "docs/customer_report.pdf"
with open(pdf_path, "rb") as f:
    part = MIMEBase("application", "octet-stream")
    part.set_payload(f.read())
    encoders.encode_base64(part)
    part.add_header("Content-Disposition", f"attachment; filename=customer_report.pdf")
    msg.attach(part)

try:
    server = smtplib.SMTP("localhost", 25, timeout=10)
    server.sendmail("agent@cuga.dev", "bob@example.com", msg.as_string())
    server.quit()
    print("Email sent successfully via localhost:25")

    try:

        server.quit()

    except Exception as e2:
        print(f"localhost:1025 failed: {e2}")
        # Save the .eml file as fallback
        eml_path = "docs/customer_report_email.eml"
        with open(eml_path, "w") as ef:
            ef.write(msg.as_string())
        print(f"Email saved as .eml file at {eml_path}")
